title: Research Ethics — Helsinki, Consent, Vulnerable Groups and Ethics Committees

hook.en: Research asks people to give time, data and sometimes their health for knowledge that may only help others. That trust is sacred. Ethics is not paperwork; it is the promise that participants will be respected, protected and treated fairly. Learn the principles and the practical steps.
hook.ur: Research logon se waqt, data aur kabhi kabhi apni sehat ka sawal karti hai us ilm ke liye jo shayad sirf doosron ki madad kare. Yeh bharosa muqaddas hai. Ethics kaghazi karwai nahi; yeh waada hai ke shirkat karne walon ki izzat, hifazat aur munsifana salook hoga. Usool aur amali qadam seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll state the core principles (respect, beneficence, justice), explain informed consent, recognise vulnerable groups, describe data protection and the role of an ethics committee, and know what not to do.
goal.ur: End tak aap bunyadi usool (izzat, bhalai, insaaf) batayenge, batayi gayi razamandi samjhayenge, kamzor groups pehchanenge, data ki hifazat aur ethics committee ka kirdar bayan karenge, aur jaanenge kya nahi karna.

text.en: Modern research ethics rests on the **Declaration of Helsinki**, which says that the well-being of participants comes before the interests of science. Three core principles are: **respect for persons** (autonomy, informed consent), **beneficence** (maximise benefits, minimise harm) and **justice** (fair selection and fair sharing of burdens and benefits). **Informed consent** means participants understand the purpose, procedures, risks, benefits and alternatives, take part **voluntarily** and can **withdraw at any time**. An **ethics committee** reviews the plan before the study starts.
text.ur: Jadeed research ethics **Declaration of Helsinki** par qaim hai, jo kehta hai ke shirkat karne walon ki bhalai science ke mufaadat se pehle hai. Teen bunyadi usool hain: **afraad ki izzat** (khud-mukhtari, batayi gayi razamandi), **bhalai** (faide zyada karna, nuqsan kam karna) aur **insaaf** (munsifana intikhab aur bojh aur faidon ki munsifana taqseem). **Batayi gayi razamandi** ka matlab hai ke shirkat karne wale maqsad, tareeqe, khatray, faide aur mutabadil samjhein, **apni marzi se** shamil hon aur **kisi bhi waqt wapas ja saken**. **Ethics committee** study shuru hone se pehle plan ka jaiza leti hai.

text.en: Think of **borrowing a neighbour's tools**. You ask permission, say what you will do, return them in good shape and never take more than agreed. Participants are lending you something far more valuable than tools: their time, their trust and sometimes their health. Ethics is how you show that you deserve it.
text.ur: **Padosi ka saman udhaar lena** sochein. Aap ijazat mangte hain, batate hain kya karenge, achhi halat mein wapas karte hain aur tay shuda se zyada nahi lete. Shirkat karne wale aap ko aise saman se kahin qeemti cheez udhaar de rahe hain: apna waqt, bharosa aur kabhi apni sehat. Ethics aap ka tareeqa hai yeh dikhane ka ke aap is ke laiq hain.

title.ur: Durust batayi gayi razamandi ke ajza

rows.en: A clear explanation of purpose, procedures, risks, benefits and alternatives
rows.ur: Maqsad, tareeqe, khatray, faide aur mutabadil ki saaf wazahat

rows.en: A plain-language information sheet in Urdu, read aloud for people who cannot read
rows.ur: Urdu mein saade alfaaz ki maloomati sheet, jo parh nahi sakte unhein zor se parh kar sunayi gayi

rows.en: The person truly understands, not just signs
rows.ur: Shakhs waqai samajhta hai, sirf dastakhat nahi karta

rows.en: Ask them to explain it back in their own words
rows.ur: Unse kahein apne alfaaz mein dohrayein

rows.en: No pressure, no loss of care for refusing
rows.ur: Koi dabao nahi, inkaar par care ka nuqsan nahi

rows.en: A person not involved in treatment seeks consent, to avoid coercion
rows.ur: Jo ilaaj mein shamil nahi woh razamandi lein, jabr se bachne ke liye

rows.en: Participants can leave at any time without giving a reason or penalty
rows.ur: Shirkat karne wale kisi bhi waqt bina wajah ya saza ke ja sakte hain

rows.en: The information sheet states this clearly and the clinic honours it
rows.ur: Maloomati sheet saaf batati hai aur clinic is ka ehtiram karta hai

question.en: A therapist asks her own patients to join her trial, saying that "it would really help me with my degree". What is the main ethical concern?
question.ur: Ek therapist apne hi mareezon ko apne trial mein shamil hone ko kehti hai, yeh kehte hue ke "meri degree mein bohat madad hogi". Sab se badi akhlaqi fikr kya hai?

text.en: No concern, since she is a professional
text.ur: Koi fikr nahi, kyunke woh peshawar hai

feedback.en: Professionals still hold power over patients.
feedback.ur: Peshawar log phir bhi mareezon par ikhtiyar rakhte hain.

text.en: Only that the trial is too small
text.ur: Sirf yeh ke trial bohat chhota hai

feedback.en: The concern is pressure, not size.
feedback.ur: Fikr dabao ki hai, size ki nahi.

text.en: Possible coercion: patients may feel they cannot refuse without harming their care
text.ur: Mumkina jabr: mareez mehsoos kar sakte hain ke inkaar karne se unki care ko nuqsan hoga

feedback.en: Yes — a person not involved in care should seek consent.
feedback.ur: Haan — jo care mein shamil na ho woh razamandi le.

question.en: A participant in a trial wants to leave halfway through. What should happen?
question.ur: Trial mein ek shirkat karne wala beech mein chhorna chahta hai. Kya hona chahiye?

text.en: They must finish to avoid wasting the study
text.ur: Unhein mukammal karna hoga taake study zaya na ho

text.en: They may withdraw at any time without penalty, and their care should continue as normal
text.ur: Woh kisi bhi waqt bina saza ke wapas ja sakta hai, aur uski care normal jari rehni chahiye

question.en: Which group needs special protection in research?
question.ur: Research mein kis group ko khaas hifazat chahiye?

text.en: Only people who are older than 80
text.ur: Sirf 80 se zyada umar ke log

text.en: Children, people with cognitive impairment, prisoners, pregnant women and people in unequal power relationships
text.ur: Bache, zehni kamzori wale log, qaidi, hamila khawateen aur na-barabar taqat ke rishton wale log

feedback.en: Yes — vulnerable groups need extra safeguards and often a proxy consent or special approval.
feedback.ur: Haan — kamzor groups ko mazeed hifazat chahiye aur aksar numainda razamandi ya khaas manzoori.

text.ur: Kisi group ko khaas hifazat nahi chahiye

text.en: **Treating ethics as a form to tick.** "Consent" signed on a thumbprint by someone who did not understand is not consent. And "it was only an audit" is not a magic phrase: if you plan to publish or generalise results, check whether ethics approval is needed. Never begin recruitment before approval. Never collect names or phone numbers you do not need. Never promise confidentiality you cannot keep.
text.ur: **Ethics ko kaaghaz par tick karne ka form samajhna.** Aise shakhs ka angootha lagana jo samjha nahi razamandi nahi. Aur "yeh sirf audit tha" jadui jumla nahi: agar aap shaya karna ya nateeje aam karna chahte hain to dekhein ke ethics ki manzoori chahiye ya nahi. Manzoori se pehle bharti kabhi shuru na karein. Woh naam ya phone number jama na karein jin ki zaroorat nahi. Woh raazdari ka waada na karein jo nibha na sakein.

text.en: **Make consent a conversation.** Use simple Urdu, short sentences and pictures. Explain what happens on the first day, what is optional and what is a risk. Offer time to think and to ask family. Give a copy to take home. In Pakistan, consider literacy, gender norms and the role of family in decisions; allow a trusted relative to attend, but make sure the individual agrees for themselves.
text.ur: **Razamandi ko baat cheet banayein.** Saada Urdu, chhote jumle aur tasveerein istemal karein. Batayein pehle din kya hoga, kya ikhtiyari hai aur kya khatra hai. Sochne aur ghar walon se poochhne ka waqt dein. Ghar le jane ke liye copy dein. Pakistan mein parhne ki salahiyat, jins ke riwaj aur faislon mein khandan ke kirdar par ghaur karein; kisi bharosemand rishtedar ko aane dein, lekin yaqeeni banayein ke shakhs khud razi ho.

question.en: What happened in the studies that created modern research ethics?
question.ur: Un studies mein kya hua jinhon ne jadeed research ethics ko janam diya?

answer.en: The Nuremberg Code (1947) followed the trial of Nazi doctors who had experimented on prisoners without consent. The Tuskegee study (1932 to 1972) left hundreds of Black men with syphilis untreated, without their knowledge, even after penicillin was available. These and other cases led to the Declaration of Helsinki (1964, many revisions), the Belmont Report (1979) and modern ethics committees. Their lesson is that harm can happen even when researchers think they are doing good.
answer.ur: Nuremberg Code (1947) un Nazi doctors ke mukadme ke baad aaya jinhon ne qaidiyon par razamandi ke baghair tajurbe kiye. Tuskegee study (1932 se 1972) ne saikron kale mardon ko unki jaankari ke baghair syphilis ke saath bina ilaaj ke chhoda, penicillin dastiyab hone ke baad bhi. In aur doosre cases se Declaration of Helsinki (1964, kai tarmeemein), Belmont Report (1979) aur jadeed ethics committees bani. In ka sabaq yeh hai ke nuqsan tab bhi ho sakta hai jab muhaqqiq samajhte hon wo achha kar rahe hain.

beats.patient: A student wants to survey patients in her clinic about pain and also record their names and phone numbers "in case I want to follow up". She plans to start next week, before approval.
beats.assessment: Names and phone numbers are not needed for an anonymous survey, and starting before approval is not allowed.
beats.treatment: She submits the protocol to the ethics committee, removes personal identifiers (using codes), writes an Urdu information sheet and a consent form, and waits for approval.
beats.reassess: The study starts three weeks later, with approval and a clear consent process.

text.en: **Protect participants first.** Define in advance what counts as a serious adverse event, whom participants call if they feel worse, and who can stop the study. If something goes wrong, report it at once to the ethics committee. Take data protection seriously: store files securely, restrict access and destroy data when you said you would.
text.ur: **Pehle shirkat karne walon ko mehfooz rakhein.** Pehle se tay karein seriyas adverse event kise kehte hain, agar bigar jaye to mareez kise phone karein, aur study kaun rok sakta hai. Agar kuch ghalat ho to foran ethics committee ko report karein. Data ki hifazat ko seriyas lein: files mehfooz rakhein, rasai mehdood karein aur jab kehte hain data tabaah karein.

text.en: The Declaration of Helsinki, adopted by the World Medical Association and revised several times, states that the duty to promote and safeguard the health of participants comes before the aims of research, that informed consent must be voluntary and that research must be reviewed by an independent committee. Emanuel, Wendler and Grady proposed seven requirements for ethical clinical research: social or scientific value, scientific validity, fair participant selection, favourable risk-benefit ratio, independent review, informed consent and respect for enrolled participants.
text.ur: World Medical Association ki apnayi hui aur kai baar nazar-e-saani shuda Declaration of Helsinki kehti hai ke shirkat karne walon ki sehat ko farogh dene aur mehfooz rakhne ka farz research ke maqasid se pehle hai, ke batayi gayi razamandi apni marzi ki ho aur research ka jaiza azaad committee le. Emanuel, Wendler aur Grady ne akhlaqi clinical research ke saat taqaze tajweez kiye: samaji ya science ki qeemat, science ki durustgi, shirkat karne walon ka munsifana intikhab, saazgar khatra-faida nisbat, azaad jaiza, batayi gayi razamandi aur bharti shuda shirkat karne walon ka ehtiram.

text.en: **Respect, Benefit, Justice, Consent.** The three principles and the practice that carries them.
text.ur: **Izzat, Bhalai, Insaaf, Razamandi.** Teen usool aur woh amal jo unhein aage le jata hai.

summary.en: Research ethics rests on respect, beneficence and justice, set out in the Declaration of Helsinki.
summary.ur: Research ethics izzat, bhalai aur insaaf par qaim hai, jo Declaration of Helsinki mein hai.

summary.en: Informed consent must be understood, voluntary and revocable; vulnerable groups need extra protection.
summary.ur: Batayi gayi razamandi samjhi hui, marzi ki aur wapas lene ke qabil honi chahiye; kamzor groups ko mazeed hifazat chahiye.

summary.en: Get ethics approval before starting, protect data and report problems immediately.
summary.ur: Shuru karne se pehle ethics ki manzoori lein, data mehfooz rakhein aur masail foran report karein.
